deadline.value: Apply by 15 November 2026 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline15 November 2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE (General or Subject) is required.

supervisor.value: No commitment is needed to apply, but you must have a supervisor to be admitted.
supervisor.quote: Whereas a commitment from a supervisor is not required prior to applying to the program, a supervisor is required for admission.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: Minimum funding per year* | *All full-time UBC PhD students receive, at a minimum, this amount of funding in each of the first four years.

entry_route.value: Apply with a master's or with a first-class bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Prerequisites include either a master's degree, or a bachelor's degree with first class standing or equivalent.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall (old 120-point scale) or 5.0 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 7.0
